cto_ruling.marker_not_emittable: unrecovered-pending-BEAAA-23845 cannot be produced by any live run. COSIGN_RE at scripts/release_gate_n5.py accepts only ^BEAAA-\d+(#comment-[0-9A-Za-z._-]+)?$ or the literal not-required-rule-execution. This is what makes the marker safe to carry on an authoritative receipt, and it is why QA finding F3 (committed corpus not self-consistent with the invariant the same commit introduces) is explicitly ACCEPTED rather than resolved.
cto_ruling.non_operative_flag_finding: The authoritative flag is read by no code. Verified independently by the CTO at 190553b2 and by QA on master fb2cf1ef across all file types, not just *.py: zero JSON/schema-key occurrences outside artifacts/ and tools/calibration-deltas/, and no property, subscript or .get() access in py/sh/yml/js/ts/go/sql. The quarantine half of the original ruling was therefore never load-bearing; the only thing protecting the record is whether the header text is true. It also means this flip cannot move N=5, so any measured movement at this SHA is a hard stop rather than something to reconcile.
